youtube.title: YouTube Dashboard
youtube.subtitle: New uploads from your subscribed channels

rss.title: News Feeds
rss.subtitle: Latest articles from your RSS & Atom feeds

youtube.addHint: Paste a YouTube channel link (@handle, /channel/UC…, video link, or RSS URL) and press Enter.
youtube.noFeeds: No channels yet – click "Add channel" on the right to get started.
youtube.confirmMarkAll: Mark all {count} videos in this list as watched?
youtube.emptyLeft: All caught up – no new videos.
youtube.emptyRight: No videos watched in the last {days} days. Tick a video on the left to move it here.
youtube.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to remove channel "{title}" and all its videos?

rss.addHint: Paste an RSS/Atom feed URL or website address and press Enter.
rss.noFeeds: No feeds yet – click "Add feed" on the right to get started.
rss.confirmMarkAll: Mark all {count} articles in this list as read?
rss.emptyLeft: All caught up – no unread news.
rss.emptyRight: No articles read in the last {days} days. Tick an article on the left to move it here.
rss.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to remove feed "{title}" and all its articles?

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize appearance, inbox display limits, and OPML backups.
settings.modeHint: Switch between Dark Mode (default) and Light Mode.
settings.themeHint: Choose from 5 syntax-inspired color palettes (Monokai is default).
settings.inboxLimitHint: Maximum number of unread news or videos shown in the inbox table (default: 100).
settings.completedDaysHint: How many days completed videos and articles stay visible in the right column (default: 7 days, max: 30 days).
settings.opmlHint: Import or export your subscribed YouTube channels and RSS feeds as standard OPML 2.0 files (including topic folders).

errors.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid link.
errors.invalid_opml: No valid feeds found in this OPML file.
errors.feed_exists: This one has already been added.
errors.youtube_channel_not_found: Couldn't find a YouTube channel for this link. Try the channel page URL (e.g. youtube.com/@name).
errors.not_a_feed: No RSS or Atom feed found at this URL.
errors.fetch_failed: The URL could not be loaded. Please check the link and try again.
